newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adsteam Marine to float on June 12.
newsitem.headline: Adsteam Marine to float on June 12.

text.p: Residual Assco Group Ltd, formerly Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd, said on Friday that its float of Adsteam Marine Ltd had been settled and the company was set to list on the Australian stock exchange on June 12.
"Shareholder statements were mailed today, following settlement, to successful applicants advising of their shareholder details in the soon to be listed Adsteam Marine Ltd," it said in a statement.

Residual has said it aimed to raise A$160 million (US$123 million) from the sale through the issue of 80 million Adsteam Marine shares at A$2.00 each, and the offer which opened on May 15 was closed early due to high interest.
The Adsteam Marine business is represented in more than 30 ports around Australia and the South Pacific region through wholly owned businesses and through joint ventures.

Adsteam Marine said in its prospectus that earnings before interest, tax and abnormals was expected to rise to A$24.4 million in the year to June 30, 1997, compared with A$23 million in the 1995/96 year.
Adsteam was one of Australia's largest corporate failures following the debt binge of the 1980s, coming under the control of its bankers in 1990 with debts of A$11 billion.
This has been reduced to less than A$700 million through the sale of its operations.
